itens.titulo: Executivos e conselheiros do Bradesco compram R$ 26,95 mi em ações
itens.descricao: Executivos e conselheiros do Bradesco compram R$ 26,95 mi em ações Poder360
trechos: As operações somaram R$ 26,95 milhões (US$ 5,24 milhões).
A maior compra foi a do diretor executivo André Luis Duarte de Oliveira, que adquiriu 309.111 ações, por R$ 5,56 milhões.
Com a operação, sua posição direta mais que dobrou, de 244.062 para 553.173 papéis.
Os dados constam de formulários Form 4 protocolados em 21 e 22 de setembro de 2026 na SEC (Securities and Exchange Commission), a Comissão de Valores Mobiliários dos Estados Unidos.
O Poder360 calculou o valor de cada operação multiplicando a quantidade de ações pelo preço de R$ 17,98.
A conversão para dólares considerou a cotação de R$ 5,14 por US$ 1 no fechamento de 18 de setembro.
O valor total de R$ 26.953.224,66 corresponde a aproximadamente US$ 5,24 milhões.
- André Luis Duarte de Oliveira (diretor executivo) – 309.111 ações (R$ 5.557.815,78).

itens.titulo: JPMorgan Chase & Co. Q3 Earnings Call Highlights
itens.descricao: JPMorgan Chase & Co. Q3 Earnings Call Highlights Yahoo Finance
trechos: - JPMorgan reported strong third-quarter results, with net income of $15.3 billion, revenue up 8% year over year to $50.9 billion, and a 20% return on tangible common equity.

- Consumer and wealth-management trends remained robust: card spending increased 10%, deposits rose 4%, client investment assets exceeded $1.4 trillion, and assets under management climbed 13% to $5.2 trillion.
- Management expects approximately $28 billion in fourth-quarter total net interest income but is becoming more selective on credit underwriting.
Revenue rose 8% from a year earlier to $50.9 billion.
Excluding $658 million of net investment securities losses in the Corporate segment, revenue increased 9%, Chief Financial Officer Jeremy Barnum said.

- Allient's Data Center and Defense Momentum Is Raising the Stakes Expenses increased 12% year over year to $27.3 billion, reflecting higher volume- and revenue-related costs, front-office hiring and wage inflation.
Credit costs totaled $2.7 billion, including $2.2 billion in net charge-offs and a $539 million net reserve build.
Business Results and Consumer Trends The Consumer & Community Banking division earned $5.7 billion, while revenue increased 9% to $21.2 billion.

itens.descricao: Lumentum Vs. Coherent: Backlog Quality Leaves Investors Spoiled for Choice Yahoo Finance
trechos: Quick Read - Lumentum (LITE) revenue more than doubled to $1B while Coherent (COHR) grew 33% to $2B, both fueled by AI datacenter optical demand.
- Lumentum's scarce high-power lasers pushed operating margins to 36.6%, but its 43x forward earnings valuation versus Coherent's 30x demands perfect execution.
- Coherent's quarterly capex surged from $131M to $556M for new wafer lines, but locked long-term pricing agreements could cap gains if laser prices rise.
Lumentum (NASDAQ:LITE) and Coherent (NYSE:COHR) both reported fiscal 2026 results in August with order books that reach into 2027 and beyond.
Lumentum's quarterly revenue more than doubled to $1.006 billion.
Coherent's grew 33.74% to $2.0455 billion.
Lumentum Runs Short of Lasers While Coherent Books Out 2027 Lumentum's quarter came down to scarcity.
Management said it is "way behind our shipments" on high-power lasers because demand sped up faster than the production ramp.
